name: r4-01-f5-split
title: Round 4 @ 9e21bf09: F5 is fixed for a text turn, not for a turn interrupted inside a tool call
subtitle: Real stack. The Harness is SIGKILLed while a channel wake turn is in flight, then the sender writes again in the same thread.

panels.h: Text turn parked at the model → recovers
panels.t:
## Bob "HOLD me T#t1" (model request held)
07:16:15 t1 reaches the model, Harness SIGKILLed
07:16:57 Harness back
## t3 in the same thread (after the writer lease lapsed)
07:19:43 POST /session          409 managed_session_already_exists
07:19:43 POST /session/7542d2a4/load  ++ 200
07:19:43 submit_input           ++ 202
++ log: Interrupted channel wake turn chin-34fc… was settled
++      without a reply; the Session stays usable.
++ t3's turn runs; reply delivered
== the model sees t1's user record and t3 merged in one
== user message, so t3's reply also answers t1
++ public-API operator turn on this Session: completed

panels.h: Turn interrupted inside a tool call → still wedged
panels.t:
## shell profile, Bob "T#s4 SLEEP:150"
07:29:27 model → run_shell_command `sleep 150` (running)
07:29:40 Harness SIGKILLed, back 07:30:21
## s5, s6 in the same thread
07:30:54 submit_input s5      ++ 200 admitted
!! log: Interrupted channel wake turn chin-93e1… was settled
!!      without a reply; the Session stays usable.
-- log: Monitor wake pump of session 91f064dc failed:
--      ManagedHarnessBlockedError: await_runtime is not
--      a model-start phase for this Harness.
07:32:40 submit_input s6      ++ 200 admitted
-- 0 model calls, 0 replies through 08:08 (38 min)
-- operator turns: failed hosted_turn_recovery_required × 2

panels.h: Why: the settlement does not move the checkpoint
panels.t:
## settleInterruptedWake → sink.write(turn_result cancelled)
## → commitTurnSettled (managed-session-record-sink.ts:312)
if phase ∈ HARNESS_MODEL_START_PHASES (:351)
  ++ commitTurnComplete → next-turn-ready checkpoint
else                                  (await_runtime)
  !! appendExecutionEvent(turn.settled) only
  !! the checkpoint stays at await_runtime
## next wake turn
-- requireModelStart (managed-harness-factory.ts:943)
-- throws ManagedHarnessBlockedError
== the unit test only covers "died before the model
== answered" (a model-start phase)

note: Measured in the shell profile, where a long-running command keeps the turn in await_runtime for its whole duration. Other tool calls pass through the same phase briefly; that window was not measured.

name: r4-02-f8-writer-lease
title: New P1 (F8): after any Harness restart, mail to every attached thread is dropped for up to the writer-lease duration (60 s)
subtitle: The dead Harness's Session Store writer lease outlives it. The re-attach answers 409 managed_session_writer_conflict until the lease lapses; Spring forwards it as 409 and the adapter drops every 409.

panels.h: PR head 9e21bf09: three restarts, three lost emails
panels.t:
## SIGKILL, thread had a turn in flight
07:17:03 /inbound t2  503 (generation mismatch, re-driven)
07:17:07 /inbound t2  -- 409 managed_session_writer_conflict
-- adapter: "admission of 1791443505:3 was refused (409);
--           the message is skipped."
## SIGKILL, idle attached thread (Alice)
07:23:24 /inbound a3  -- 409 writer_conflict → skipped
## graceful SIGTERM (Harness exited in 1 s)
07:25:13 /inbound a5  -- 409 writer_conflict → skipped
== each ingress row stays staged; no reply, no retry
== Harness itself calls this "the one 409 whose wait
== self-heals when the lease lapses" (hosted-harness-session.ts:3075)

## TRANSIENT_HARNESS_CONFLICTS =
##   managed_session_writer_conflict, workspace_busy,
##   workspace_unavailable, hosted_session_closing
07:55:41 Harness SIGKILLed (Alice's thread attached)
07:56:24 /inbound a7  !! 503 channel_operation_failed
07:56:27 /inbound a7  !! 503 managed_session_writer_conflict ×2
07:56:44 /inbound a7  ++ 200 admitted (lease lapsed, +63 s)
++ reply 26 s after the email was sent
++ deterministic channel 409s (channel_operation_conflict,
++ channel_generation_stale …) keep their 409 class
== ManagedChannelServiceTest: new test red on the head's
== source (expected 503, was 409), green with the patch

note: This is the 'transient 409 classified as permanent' gap noted under F3 in rounds 2–3, now reproduced end to end. A routine Harness deploy loses every email that lands on an attached thread in the lease window.

name: r4-03-f6-still
title: F6 (P1) is unchanged at 9e21bf09; the combined candidate handles both refusal classes
subtitle: Simulated close of a route Session while its reply is held 20 s at SMTP (Session row → CLOSED + Spring restart drops the cached attachment), then Bob starts a new thread.

panels.t:
## same scenario as round 3
-- Alice's receipt refused 409 × 40, every ~3 s
-- outbox claims afterwards: 0
-- Bob's new thread: no reply for 2 min 8 s, until the
--   Session row was set back to ACTIVE by hand
== managed-email-adapter.ts is byte-identical to round 3

## Spring failed to restart for 3 min (rig port race)
07:57:35 → 08:00:53 receipt  !! ECONNREFUSED × 35
++ transient: the entry is kept and re-driven
++ Bob's email waits as pending, nothing dropped
## Spring back
08:01:01 receipt (Alice)     !! 409 → dropped, logged
08:01:04 /inbound (Bob)      ++ 200 admitted
08:01:07 receipt (Bob)       ++ 200 delivered
== transient keeps, deterministic drops: both classes
== behave as intended in one run

note: candidate-r4.patch = round-3 adapter fix (F6) + translate() fix (F8): 4 files, +110/−5. Java 63/63 (ManagedChannelServiceTest 13 incl. the new test, QwenHostedHarnessConnectorTest 47, ChannelContractTest 3), checkstyle clean; email 50/50, prettier clean.
